themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents performing research tasks autonomously, from data analysis to report generation, often involving interaction and decision-making.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and optimizing code, including code generation and review.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI applications designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Articles discussing the creation and use of artificial users or personas for testing, simulation, and research purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the research surrounding AI chatbots, their capabilities, limitations, user interactions, and psychological impacts.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in information extraction.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications specifically designed to enhance UX design processes, prototyping, and user research methodologies.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Articles detailing how AI is used to analyze user feedback, reviews, and sentiment to extract insights.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI applications that aid in the creation, distribution, and analysis of surveys to gather user data.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Examines the impact of AI on job markets, recruitment processes, and workforce dynamics, including job displacement and skill shifts.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
